title: Lex eterna
html_source:
This is a reference to Thomas Aquinas' concept of the “lex eterna”, or divine eternal law.

“I never broke the law. I AM THE LAW.”

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: “While not as yet exisiting in themselves things nevertheless exist in God insofar as they are foreseen and preordained by Him.”

This explains how Christ can have been begotten by God while also being consubstantial- that is coeternal- with Him.

From “‘Strandentwining Cable’: Joyce, Flaubert, and Intertextuality” by Scarlett Baron
